title: Create in Me a Clean Heart

request.style: English, piano ballad, intimate broken male vocal, solo piano, cello, soft string pads, quiet and confessional, 68 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Against you, you alone, have I sinned
And my sin is always there before me again
I have done what is evil in your sight, I know
Have mercy on me, O God, and do not let me go

[Chorus]
Create in me a clean heart, O God
And renew a steadfast spirit within me
Do not cast me from your presence
And do not take your holy Spirit from me

[Verse]
Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean
Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow
The bones that you have broken, let them sing
Let me hear the joy and gladness that you bring

[Chorus]
Create in me a clean heart, O God
And renew a steadfast spirit within me
Do not cast me from your presence
And do not take your holy Spirit from me

[Bridge]
Restore to me the joy of your salvation
And sustain me with a willing spirit
A broken and crushed heart, O God, you will not despise

[Outro]
Create in me a clean heart, O God
Create in me a clean heart
